The following events took place in '''4166 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Proem==
Centuries before this year, the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] developed an interstellar federation without any influence from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. At some point they invented the [[cavitation hyperdrive]], which allowed them to establish colonies on [[Ruisto]], [[Mantan]], and [[Hinakuu]] from [[4400 BBY|4400]] to [[4200 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" />

==The galaxy in 4166 BBY==
In 4166 BBY, Republic scouts clearing the rimward end of the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] made contact with Mon Calamari [[Starship/Legends|starships]] near Ruisto.<ref name="TEA" />

==Impact==
For millennia, interaction between the Republic and the Mon Calamari remained minimal, and during the latter years of the Republic, [[Calamari sector/Legends|Mon Calamari Space]] was represented in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] as an [[Allied Region]]. During the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Mon Calamari forced the withdrawal of an Imperial occupation force in an unprecedented uprising and covertly gave their support to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. Their shipyards' [[MC80 Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 Star Cruisers]] proved to be an equalizing factor in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], and after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Mon Calamari Space became a founding member of the short-lived [[Alliance of Free Planets]]. The region later became an important constituency of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Notable events==
*Republic scouts made first contact with Mon Calamari starships.<ref name="TEA" />
